title: SimpleAnnouncer
description: A lightweight, fully customizable announcement plugin that broadcasts colored messages from a simple text file at timed intervals.
body:
Simple Announcements is a clean, efficient plugin designed for servers that want timed broadcast messages without wrestling with complicated configs or bloated feature lists. Messages are controlled through a single config.txt located inside the SimpleAnnouncementsConfig folder, allowing server owners to quickly add, edit, or remove announcements with ease. Each line defines a color and a message, and the plugin automatically formats, validates, and rotates through them at your chosen interval.

To adjust how often announcements are sent, go to:
Plugins > SimpleAnnouncer > config.yml
Set the time (in minutes) between each message.
Example: frequency: 10
This means a random announcement is broadcast every 10 minutes.

To edit the announcements themselves, go to:
Plugins > SimpleAnnouncer > SimpleAnnouncementsConfig > config.txt
Each line must follow the format:
COLOR,Your message here

Example:
RED,Don't forget to check out our website!
